semantic_contract.task_statement: Find the square root of a non-negative integer using binary search.

result.canonical_semantics: Floor of the non-negative integer square root.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite evaluates integer square root for zero, one, a perfect square, two non-perfect squares and a larger non-perfect square. Negative integers are evaluated separately as semantic-boundary probes.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 6 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: Negative integers are outside the NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER contract and are reported separately through semantic-boundary variance.
